purpose: The provider-mandated hierarchical branch-key store. Key attribute names are branch-key-id and type because the AWS Encryption SDK hierarchical keyring defines them; this is the one table that does not use the pk and sk convention, and the deviation is deliberate. The logical key store name equals the physical table name and is cryptographically bound to every record, so it can never be changed after first use.

serverSideEncryption.rationale: Deleting this table permanently destroys every workspace secret, so it carries its own CMK and its own deletion protection.

stream.rationale: Wrapped branch-key material must never appear on a change feed.

timeToLive.rationale: A branch key is decryptable material for every ciphertext ever sealed under it; expiry by TTL would silently destroy customer secrets.
